The '''Volgastani-Hamed Empire''' was an absolute monarchy in Khalari. The source list of defunct nations gives its formation as 723 and its end as 1892.

== Regional Role ==

The empire appears in Northern Alliance source material as an eastern power that earlier Theorin-Vinterholm cooperation sought to contain. It later became one of the central opponents of the [[Svetian War]] of 1880-1884, fighting against a coalition supported by the [[Northern Alliance]] and the [[Vesperan Empire]].

== Svetian War ==

During the [[Svetian War]], the empire and the [[Arabogradsk-Hamed Caliphate]] opposed the Northern Alliance-backed expedition. The source says Volgastani-Arabogradsk armies were defeated at the [[Battle of Kaplan Ridge]] in 1882 and that the war ended in 1884 with reparations and the establishment of a diplomatic quarter in [[Murah]].

== Collapse ==

The 1891 [[Volgastani Summer Revolution]] and [[Siege of Murah]] exposed internal discontent after defeat, economic pressure, and anti-foreign anger. The empire is listed as defunct in 1892, one year after the Murah crisis.

== Legacy ==

The later [[Volgastan Baathist Republic]] was established in 1953, but this draft does not treat it as a direct legal continuation of the Volgastani-Hamed Empire. It preserves the older empire as a major premodern and nineteenth-century Khalari power.
